shared: Pale olms that are weak early, bank something up over many turns, then wake huge late.
differ: What the sleep builds: a shared countdown tally, Age you can move, or Rest that doubles buffs.

takes.label: Countdown clockwork
takes.line: Units run Vigil countdowns; every finish adds Dripstone that never drops, and Knockers and Netopir make clock timing a puzzle.
takes.look_if: a timing puzzle of short clocks feeding long ones.

takes.label: Pass the Age
takes.line: Untouched units gain Age you can move along the row with Netopir, tipping Awaken thresholds; the Eldest's Awaken 20 doubles your board.
takes.look_if: placement puzzles, routing Age to hit big one-off thresholds.

takes.label: Buffs land twice
takes.line: Resting units take every permanent buff twice, from any tribe; emptying Rest sets off Wake chains, or the Dragon floods it out.
takes.look_if: to double other tribes' growth through cross-tribe combos.
